items.guidance: MOM lists the full name of the employer as Key Employment Term item 1.
MOM lists the full name of the employee as Key Employment Term item 2.

items.term: Job title, main duties and responsibilities
items.guidance: MOM lists job title, main duties and responsibilities as item 3. TAFEP says offers should set out key terms such as responsibilities.
MOM lists the start date as item 4. TAFEP says offers should set out key terms such as start date.
MOM lists duration of employment, for employees on a fixed-term contract, as item 5.
items.applies: only if fixed-term; not_applicable if the letter says permanent

items.term: Working arrangements: daily working hours, number of working days per week, rest day
items.guidance: MOM lists working arrangements (daily working hours, working days per week, rest day) as item 6.
MOM lists the salary period as item 7.

items.term: Basic salary (for hourly, daily or piece-rated workers, the basic rate of pay)
items.guidance: MOM lists basic salary as item 8; for hourly, daily or piece-rated workers the basic rate of pay should also be indicated. TAFEP says offers should set out key terms such as salary.
MOM lists fixed allowances as item 9.
items.applies: always (a statement that there are none counts as stated)

items.guidance: MOM lists fixed deductions as item 10.
items.applies: always (a statement that there are none counts as stated)

items.term: Overtime payment period (if different from the salary period)
items.guidance: MOM lists the overtime payment period, if different from the salary period, as item 11. MOM says items 11 and 12 need not be included for a PME to whom overtime pay does not apply.
items.applies: only if overtime pay applies; not_applicable if the letter says the role is not eligible for overtime pay

items.guidance: MOM lists the overtime rate of pay as item 12. MOM says items 11 and 12 need not be included for a PME to whom overtime pay does not apply.
items.applies: only if overtime pay applies; not_applicable if the letter says the role is not eligible for overtime pay

items.term: Other salary-related components such as bonuses and incentives
items.guidance: MOM lists other salary-related components, such as bonuses and incentives, as item 13.
items.applies: always (a statement that there are none counts as stated)

items.term: Types of leave: annual, outpatient sick, hospitalisation, maternity, childcare
items.guidance: MOM lists the types of leave (annual, outpatient sick, hospitalisation, maternity, childcare) as item 14.

items.term: Other medical benefits such as insurance, medical and dental benefits
items.guidance: MOM lists other medical benefits (insurance, medical, dental) as item 15. TAFEP says offers should set out key terms such as benefits.
items.applies: always (a statement that there are none counts as stated)

items.guidance: MOM lists the probation period as item 16. MOM says notice during probation is the same as after confirmation unless the contract sets a different probation notice.
items.applies: always (a statement that there is none counts as stated)

items.guidance: MOM lists the notice period as item 17. MOM says that if the contract does not specify a notice period, it depends on length of service: under 26 weeks 1 day; 26 weeks to under 2 years 1 week; 2 years to under 5 years 2 weeks; 5 years or more 4 weeks.
MOM lists place of work as an optional item 18 and strongly encourages including it, used if the work location differs from the employer's address.

items.term: Time to consider the offer (a response deadline or stated period to clarify and decide)
items.guidance: TAFEP says candidates should get sufficient time and opportunity to clarify and consider the terms and conditions of the offer before acceptance. TAFEP gives no number of days.

consistency_rule.guidance: The TAFEP Handbook says contracts should be clearly written and include Key Employment Terms, and that at the point of job offer all relevant information regarding employment terms must be in place.
